Class RecyclableArrayList

java.lang.Object
java.util.AbstractCollection<Object>
java.util.AbstractList<Object>
java.util.ArrayList<Object>
io.netty.util.internal.RecyclableArrayList
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable, Iterable<Object>, Collection<Object>, List<Object>, RandomAccess
public final class RecyclableArrayList extends ArrayList<Object>
A simple list which is recyclable. This implementation does not allow null elements to be added.
